decisions.decision: Pattern programmer (PR #89) removed entirely — wrong abstraction
decisions.rationale: Companion's true shape is capture-and-replay (looper-style), not rhythmic-mask-on-held-inputs. Pattern was an awkward intermediate.

decisions.decision: LooperLane is the primary companion abstraction — first concrete Lane impl in Phase 2
decisions.rationale: Captures user's played notes, replays through harmony engine. Maps to user's vision of 'companion that plays alongside you'.

decisions.decision: State machine architecture: Lane trait + WorldState + 3-phase orchestration
decisions.rationale: Six of nine jam-pipeline weeks fit cleanly as Lane impls; phase ordering (Sense → Mutate → Decide) makes feedback loops well-defined.

decisions.decision: Audio graph (DAG) replaces linear chain in src/chain/
decisions.rationale: Linear chain can't express multiple sources mixed before FX, sidechaining, parallel sends. BeatMachine + DrumSampler need parallel sources immediately.

decisions.decision: Plugin support: PluginNode wrapping Box<dyn PluginInstance>; CLAP/VST3/AU/LV2 adapters
decisions.rationale: Plugins can be effects too — 'ClapInstrument' was wrong naming. Format-agnostic Node wrapper, role determined at instantiation.

decisions.decision: Sidechaining first-class — typed sidechain ports + SidechainSense Node
decisions.rationale: Real audio rigs need ducking, parallel compression, multiband sidechain. Architecture supports it from day 1.

decisions.decision: Rig saving: versioned JSON schema with migration framework
decisions.rationale: User explicitly elevated rig saving as first-class feature. Native filesystem + WASM IndexedDB + import/export interop.

decisions.decision: Elixir wavetable synth (Serum-class) replaces BasicSynth long-term
decisions.rationale: BasicSynth was placeholder. Elixir is its own phase track (E0-E12), parallel to Companion phases.

decisions.decision: BeatMachine = Logic Pro Drummer-style smart drummer (not basic step sequencer)
decisions.rationale: User vision: drummer presets, X/Y intensity, auto-fills, internal Rust drum sampler, per-element overrides.

decisions.decision: Three-thread architecture: audio (RT lock-free) / router (companion + WorldState) / main (Tauri/UI)
decisions.rationale: Audio thread MUST be lock-free; companion runs on router thread; main thread handles UI commands.
Uniform parameter interface for UI, MIDI Learn, mod matrix, rig save. Atomic-backed default impl with per-param 5ms smoothing.
Standard Rust ecosystem default; Apache patent grant; MIT for adoption.

decisions.decision: Standalone Elixir first per Elixir DESIGN.md (re-eval gate after E5-E7)
decisions.rationale: Elixir is its own product. Contrapunk integration at E11.

decisions.decision: v1.1.0 named 'Kondo KITT' (Koji Kondo + Knight Rider's KITT)
decisions.rationale: Wk 1 jam composer + recognizable robot; cohesive marketing for May 1 jam launch. Formula from scripts/release-name.py.
